flashcard_questions.q: A factor from inside the body that influences the risk of injury.
A personal characteristic such as age, gender, fitness or experience that affects the likelihood of injury.
A mental or emotional factor such as motivation, arousal, anxiety, confidence or aggression that can influence performance and injury risk.

flashcard_questions.a: The level of physical and mental alertness or excitement a performer experiences.
Deliberate physical aggression aimed at an opponent with the intent to harm, outside the rules of the sport.
